description: This file defines an internal class `AdoNetStreamFailureHandler` implementing `IStreamFailureHandler`. It handles failures in streaming by attempting to move messages to dead letters, with logging support and error handling.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: Handles stream delivery failures by moving messages to dead letters with logging and error handling.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Handles delivery failure by delegating to OnFailureAsync.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Handles subscription failure by delegating to OnFailureAsync.

methods.name: OnFailureAsync
methods.description: Performs the core logic of moving a failed message to dead letters, with exception handling.

methods.name: LogMovedMessage
methods.description: Logs the event of successfully moved message to dead letters.

methods.name: LogFailedToMoveMessage
methods.description: Logs an error if moving message to dead letters failed.
